sections.name: CrewStandingsPage
sections.title: Crew standings page
sections.what: Checks membership, loads the standings, and shows a ranked list with each member's points and a note on who the viewer is.
sections.why: The page is limited to members because the standings are only for the crew.
sections.watch_out: Each rank is just the list position, so two members with equal points still get different rank numbers.

summary: The crew standings page. It lists each member with their points from scored matches, and shows a not-found page to anyone who is not a member.
purpose: Shows how the crew members compare on points.
why: The page says points are bragging rights only, which keeps the mood friendly and avoids money language.
how: 1) Reads the crew id from the address. 2) Checks the viewer is a member, or shows not-found. 3) Loads the standings. 4) Shows a ranked list with the viewer marked as you.
inputs: The crew id in the address and the signed-in user.
outputs: A page with a ranked list of members and their points.
risks: Ranks are simply list positions, so tied members show different numbers.
debug: If the list is empty, check the standings function in the contests service. If a non-member sees the page, check the membership lookup.
